title: Zimbabwe's Security Sector Gets Major Boost in 2027 Budget
desc: Zimbabwe's security-related ministries have been allocated a combined ZWG59.5 billion in the 2027 Budget presented by Finance Minister Mthuli Ncube. The allocations include ZWG23.4 billion for Defence, ZWG20.5 billion for Home Affairs and ZWG15.6 billion for the Office of the President and Cabinet. The budget has raised questions about government spending priorities, particularly as agriculture, food security and climate resilience face growing pressure from a looming El Niño-induced drought....
